notes.title: Free To Play
notes.notes:
[h1][b]DomiCard Will Be Free for All Starting September 26th, 2024, 00:00 (UTC+10)![/b][/h1]

Thank you to everyone who has played and supported DomiCard. I’ve read your reviews and feedback, and I understand the game may not be as entertaining as it could be for some of you right now.

[h2]Exciting News: The Next Generation of DomiCard Is on the Way![/h2]

I’m currently working on a next-generation version of DomiCard with many exciting improvements. While I haven’t decided if it will be a DLC or a new game, here’s what you can expect:
[list]
[*] A better tutorial section
[*] More in-game props
[*] Improved physics and rendering performance
[*] Tools to make playing dominoes easier and more convenient
[*] Hopefully, a more interesting and engaging gameplay experience!
[/list]
The new version will be free for everyone, with all features included except for online multiplayer, as hosting servers comes with costs.

[h3]Feel free to leave your comments or suggestions below. Your feedback is always welcome![/h3]

notes.title: Major Update: Magic Wand!
notes.notes:
This is a major update of the game content, we have a new in game tool (toy), the Magic Wand! Only available in Single-player mode. [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33334648/a195d10afb4024641573f8ece469474d025cad9e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33334648/a28fb1aab82c3a5c118e220f96c5aafd5a5b9f7d.png[/img][/url]
[b]The purpose of this game should be that let everyone can have fun with domino games.[/b]
I used to say that I will not add those "cheat functions" in this domino game, and would like to keep it as a "strong patience required" game. However, this requirement seems to be not suitable for a lot of people. So, here it is, a "high technology" product has been added into DomiCard, the Magic Wand.
Wish there are more benefits than drawbacks. 

How to use it:
Open the inventory and drag it to an item bar, press the right number(keyboard button) and you will see the Magic Wand is following your mouse.
[list]
[*] To draw a line of Dominoes: hold "L Shift" and the mouse left button, start to draw! Also, you can pick a colour, and use a different type of dominoes.[previewyoutube=WCtp-awYP8Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] To auto generate dominoes with a PNG image: firstly, open the Menu (press "ESC", or [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33334648/fb2eb1491d137c424a52e0f7ee82d206c86e25bc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33334648/2f565cd073c6c5712a62a570517e962e062a8d1e.png[/img][/url]). Click on the PNG button, pick a local saved PNG file and then place it into the game (the image can be scaled or rotated in game).
Secondly, use the Magic Wand, one left mouse button click to see the square of fake dominoes, click again if you don't like them. If you like them, hold "L Shift" and click left button again you will find the magic![previewyoutube=GAlBMGswdvc;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]

[u][b]Please keep this in mind, save your work frequently![/b][/u]

notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Resolution issue has been fixed. (I wish!)
[/list]

Notes:
Some players may have the patience to build and play with thousands of dominos in the game. However, the hardware of your computer may refuse to present a smooth game. I was trying to make some optimization to solve this problem, but I failed. 
Some of you may know that the Minecraft team was trying to make a high poly version of Minecraft, and the latest news was they stopped.
So, I changed the "Fastest" quality to a lower poly model. It may break your eyes, but more friendly with your computer.

This will not be the final update.

notes.title: Clean the scene when loading a project is optional.
notes.notes:
Add a new toggle in the "Control Settings" - "Clean the scene when load projects".
If the toggle is on, the whole scene will be cleaned when loading a project. Otherwise, game objects in this scene will not be affected.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33334648/3c9bb06535609712e3c7a9528672dce0782a3905.png[/img]

[i]The default setting was clean the scene in Single-player mode, but opposite in LAN and online mode.[/i]
[i]The default setting, for now, is clean the scene in every game mode. Please be aware of this.[/i]

notes.title: 01/Mar/2019 Update: Select and pack cubes into a group
notes.notes:
A new feature added in DomiCard.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33334648/ec07bf72beec9ff4249c9be606b9d613b8002f87.gif[/img]

Players can select existing cubes and pack them into one group. After that, you can simply build cubes in this group with one click!

[list]
[*] Start selecting: Left click on the "Plus" button to start selecting cubes. Holding "Left Shift" and click the left mouse button to select cubes one by one (click on the selected cube to unselect it).
[*] Finish selecting: Left click on the "Yes" button to finish the selecting. The group of selected cubes will be displayed in that area.
[*] Use the group: Left click on the group of cubes, then those cubes will be following your mouse position.
[*] Delete the group: Right click on the group of cubes, then delete this group.
[/list]

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year
notes.notes:
Happy Lunar New Year to everybody, I hope you can enjoy this festival (not only the Steam discount event).
DomiCard has been published for almost six months from last August to now. This is my first published work, and I feel so good to see that you guys playing my game and making comments. Thanks again to everyone and I wish to see more and more people that give me feedback and enjoy the game.
Also, as an indie game developer, I will do my best to optimize and develop this game. As I have promised at the beginning, I made this game from only support single-player to multiplayer (LAN and online), and I hope to have more feedback and support from players in the future.
The next mission is, I will add some new optional scene maps (no longer empty). These new maps might be published as DLCs (free) because the game only takes hundreds of MBs right now and the added map may take more than a GB. Therefore, players can make the decision by yourselves to choose whether to add the DLC or not (there will be no extra functions, only has a new scene map).
Best wishes,
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: DomiCard online is available now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33334648/3d077c8f640a5065a1ccc9262d7031f6625eb9b0.gif[/img]

You can play DomiCard with friends online now, not only in a local area network environment. Click on the WAN Game button at the start scene, create a room, and ask your friends to join you!

For more details of DomiCard online:
[list]
[*] Player will log into the online server with his/her own Steam name and avatar.
[*] The online server is using Photon Cloud server. It has Cloud servers in up to 13 regions. In the game, it will auto connect the best region (the one has the lowest latency) and you can manually select a region as well. Rooms are only visible for the players in the same region. But the Chat is globally (chat server is in Europe).
[*] Currently, the online game only can maintain up to 20 concurrent users. But, I will upgrade it if necessary. (It costs money as you know.)
[*] Be aware of bugs.ːsteammockingː
[/list]

notes.title: 16/Nov/2018 in-game FPS limited
notes.notes:
In-game FPS is limited to 60 frame per second. As a result, the game will not take that high CPU as before. 
For example, it took me more than 50% of CPU (i7-6700) when I ran this game with no dominos or cubes. It is because the FPS was not limited, and it went as high as possible at PC platform. Right now, it only takes around 10% when there is nothing in the game.

notes.title: 14/Nov/2018 update & debug
notes.notes:
Optimization and debug are never going to end.ːsteamsadː
Sometimes I just feel while optimizing my game, The game actually wasn't improved much, but I receive some new bugs as a reward. 
So, here we are again.

[list]
[*] Update:
[list]
[*] Saved the CPU and GPU to a certain extent by optimizing graphics. Only if you use the colours contained in the pallet. Otherwise, the hardware cost will just like the previous release.
[/list]
[*] Debug:
[list]
[*] Fixed that the sound effects cost too much computer property. Right now, feel free to keep the Sound Effect on, and enjoy the card collision sound.
[*] Fixed some bugs that related to language setting, resolution setting, and quality setting.
[*] Fixed the bug which player could not load saved cubes correctly in the Multiplayer environment.
[/list]
[/list]

This is not the last "Update & Debug" notes.

notes.title: More features, same prize!
notes.notes:
I wish to say "More features, more discount". But, Value says I need to wait six more weeks to add a new discount. HOWEVER, season sale is coming!!![u][b] -35%[/b][/u] this Steam Autumn Sale!
 So, there it is.ːsteammockingː
New features added in the game.
[list]
[*] Players can modify the moving speed in the game. This would be more helpful when you want to take a video.
[*] A more friendly building function, which is you can more easily align other cubes that already exist when building new cubes or dominos. I personally feel this brings a lot of convenience to me when I build a house or a bridge. Have a look at the video! [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2G5kioLxm30]DomiCard example04[/url] 
[/list]

For more update and debugs information, please go to read the "11/Nov/2018 update & debug".

Have a nice day.ːsteamhappyː

notes.notes:
